JavaScript

// 计算斐波那契数列
function fibonacci(n) {
  if (n <= 1) return n
  let a = 0
  let b = 1
  for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
    const temp = a + b
    a = b
    b = temp
  }
  return b
}

// 使用 async/await 处理异步
async function fetchData(url) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url)
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)
    }
    const data = await response.json()
    return data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('请求失败：', error)
    return null
  }
}

CSS

/* 卡片样式 */
.card {
  max-width: 320px;
  margin: 1rem auto;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: var(--c-bg-soft, #f7f8fa);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.card h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--c-text, #2c3e50);
}

.card button {
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
  background: var(--c-brand, #3eaf7c);
  color: #ffffff;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* 响应式布局 */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .card {
    margin: 0.5rem;
    padding: 1rem;
  }
}

Vue

<template>
  <div class="counter">
    <p>当前计数：{{ count }}</p>
    <button type="button" @click="increment">增加</button>
    <button type="button" @click="decrement">减少</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'

// 计数器状态
const count = ref(0)

// 派生状态：是否为偶数
const isEven = computed(() => count.value % 2 === 0)

// 操作方法
function increment() {
  count.value++
}

function decrement() {
  count.value--
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.counter {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
.counter p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}
.counter button {
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border, #eaecef);
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}
</style>

Rust

// 定义一个简单的结构体
struct Rectangle {
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
}

impl Rectangle {
    // 关联函数：构造函数
    fn new(width: u32, height: u32) -> Self {
        Self { width, height }
    }

    // 方法：计算面积
    fn area(&self) -> u32 {
        self.width * self.height
    }
}

// 主函数
fn main() {
    let rect = Rectangle::new(10, 20);
    println!("矩形的面积是：{}", rect.area());

    // 使用迭代器和闭包
    let numbers = vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    let sum: u32 = numbers.iter().map(|x| x * 2).sum();
    println!("双倍后的总和：{}", sum);
}
